items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, alert expansion, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, and advertising. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; keep external outreach unsent; continue bounded read-only evidence work only. Evidence: upstream API rights for storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, and monetization are not established; all 4 legal launch tasks remain open; accuracy/freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; revenue is limited to 2026-09-21 with $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. Existing progress includes official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and private-gate evidence; none establishes launch permission or complete processing controls. No task is closable. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required because current evidence does not establish rights to fetch, store, transform, display, cache, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks, images, prices, savings claims, or monetize through affiliates or advertising. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and failed or unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Analytics gaps alone do not block ordinary growth on otherwise evidenced live sites. Next evidence action for each parked site: complete a timestamped checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent and cookie behavior, privacy and terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns where applicable, then record exactly one disposition: retain parked or bounded launch.
